title: az boards work-item show --id ${id} --output json
description: One work item, whose title, state, and assignee kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` (forge/ado:issue-title, forge/ado:issue-state, forge/ado:issue-assignees, and forge/ado:issue-unassign through it, with `modules/jq/forge.jq`'s ado_closed and ado_assignees), whose calls through forge/ado:az also carry --org ${organization} --detect false --only-show-errors, and in `modules/bash/tracker/ado.sh` (tracker/ado:show for tracker/ado:title, tracker/ado:state, tracker/ado:assignees, and tracker/ado:unassign), whose calls carry --org ${organization} alone. The type is WorkItem, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/wit/work-items/get-work-item?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1, whose fields az prints as the service gives them, a field with no value left out, and whose field names and types are those of https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/devops/boards/work-items/guidance/work-item-field.

System.State.description: The process template's state: Closed, Done, and Removed are closed, any other open.

System.AssignedTo.description: An IdentityRef, left out when nobody is assigned; uniqueName is the login az signs in as.

System.Tags.description: The tags, one text joined by "; ", left out when there are none.
